title: SigRegistry single-pane fleet
description: The Signature Model Registry is a Signature original: one control plane that inventories vLLM-style and TGI-style servers alike, with endpoint entries, GPU maps, and routing policies declared in one signed fleet file. Its entry schema, heartbeat protocol, and gateway are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('sigfleet.yaml -> one control plane for all local servers')
print('edition: Signature original')
demo.expected_output:
sigfleet.yaml -> one control plane for all local servers
edition: Signature original

title: SigEntry self-describing servers
description: SigEntry servers announce themselves with a signed manifest (model, revision, flags, capacity, GPU list) and renew a heartbeat lease; the registry drops entries whose lease lapses. The manifest format and lease protocol are Signature-original.

demo.program: print('manifest + heartbeat lease; lapsed lease = dropped entry')
demo.expected_output: manifest + heartbeat lease; lapsed lease = dropped entry

title: SigRoute policy routing
description: SigRoute supports round-robin, least-loaded, affinity, and cost-aware policies (prefer the cheapest idle GPU that fits) chosen per model. The cost-aware policy and per-model policy selection are Signature-original.

title: SigWatch health intelligence
description: SigWatch combines endpoint health, GPU telemetry (temperature, throttling), and error rates into a single server score; low-score servers drain gracefully before they fail hard. The composite scoring is Signature-original.
